
REMOVE-ARCHITECTURE-NOTE
Remove architecture note from work unit by index

WHEN TO USE
  Use when you need to remove an incorrect or outdated architecture note from a work unit. View current notes with show-work-unit to see indices.

USAGE
  fspec remove-architecture-note <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID (e.g., WORK-001)
  <index> (required)
    Index of note to remove (0-based, see show-work-unit output)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. First, view architecture notes with their indices
  $ fspec show-work-unit WORK-001
  Architecture Notes:
  0. Uses @cucumber/gherkin parser
  1. Must complete validation within 2 seconds
  2. Share validation logic with formatter

  2. Remove note at index 1 (the performance requirement)
  $ fspec remove-architecture-note WORK-001 1
  ✓ Architecture note removed successfully

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Work unit has no architecture notes
    Fix: Verify work unit has notes using show-work-unit command

  ✗ Invalid index N. Work unit has M architecture note(s)
    Fix: Use show-work-unit to see valid indices (0-based)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec add-architecture-note
  fspec generate-scenarios

NOTES
  • Indices are 0-based (first note is index 0)
  • Use show-work-unit to view current notes and their indices
  • Removing a note will shift subsequent indices down by 1
